name: keepa-adapter
description: MCP server for Keepa Amazon product monitoring tools.
long_description: Keepa Adapter exposes Keepa Amazon product monitoring data as MCP tools for product lookup, price history, buy box analysis, variation checks, monitoring snapshots, promotions, sales history, seller stats, and category intelligence.

tools.name: keepa_get_product
tools.description: Fetch current product data for ASINs from Keepa.

tools.name: keepa_get_price_history
tools.description: Get price, rank, rating, and review history for ASINs.

tools.name: keepa_get_buy_box
tools.description: Get buy box ownership and offer information for ASINs.

tools.name: keepa_get_variations
tools.description: Get variation family relationships and attributes for an ASIN.

tools.name: keepa_check_tokens
tools.description: Check remaining Keepa API tokens and refresh rate.

tools.name: keepa_track_asins
tools.description: Add ASINs to the adapter's local monitoring list.

tools.name: keepa_take_snapshot
tools.description: Fetch and store snapshots for tracked ASINs.

tools.name: keepa_get_changes
tools.description: Query detected product changes.

tools.name: keepa_analyze_bsr_trend
tools.description: Analyze BSR trend patterns for ASINs.

tools.name: keepa_check_variations
tools.description: Check variation families for drift and orphaned children.

tools.name: keepa_add_promo
tools.description: Register a promotional event for an ASIN.

tools.name: keepa_list_promos
tools.description: List promotional events.

tools.name: keepa_analyze_promo_impact
tools.description: Measure promotional lift using rank and price data.

tools.name: keepa_get_sales_history
tools.description: Get monthly sales volume history for ASINs.

tools.name: keepa_get_deals
tools.description: Get ASIN-specific promotion history from Keepa product data.

tools.name: keepa_get_seller_stats
tools.description: Get buy box statistics by seller for ASINs.

tools.name: keepa_get_best_sellers
tools.description: Get best seller ASINs for a category.

tools.name: keepa_get_category
tools.description: Look up Keepa category details.

tools.name: keepa_search_products
tools.description: Search Amazon products by keyword.

tools.name: keepa_find_products
tools.description: Run a Keepa Product Finder query.

tools.name: keepa_browse_deals
tools.description: Browse recent marketplace deals through Keepa's deal endpoint.

tools.name: keepa_search_categories
tools.description: Search Amazon categories by name.

tools.name: keepa_get_sellers
tools.description: Retrieve seller information by seller ID.

tools.name: keepa_find_sellers
tools.description: Run a Keepa Seller Finder query.

tools.name: keepa_get_top_sellers
tools.description: Retrieve the most-rated sellers for a locale.

tools.name: keepa_get_lightning_deals
tools.description: Retrieve one or all current Lightning Deals.

tools.name: keepa_get_graph_image
tools.description: Render a product history graph as a PNG image.

tools.name: keepa_add_api_trackings
tools.description: Add Keepa-hosted API trackings.

tools.name: keepa_remove_api_tracking
tools.description: Remove Keepa-hosted API trackings.

tools.name: keepa_get_api_trackings
tools.description: Retrieve Keepa-hosted API trackings.

tools.name: keepa_get_tracking_notifications
tools.description: Retrieve Keepa tracking notifications.

tools.name: keepa_get_tracking_lists
tools.description: List named Keepa tracking lists.

tools.name: keepa_set_tracking_webhook
tools.description: Configure the Keepa tracking webhook.
